description: This file provides a utility class for managing test sharding configurations, reading JSON configuration files, and determining test allocation across shards for a specific platform.

classes.name: ShardingTestConfig
classes.description: Encapsulates sharding configuration for a platform, including reading config files, creating default shards, and determining test run configurations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the sharding configuration, reads config if not provided, and creates a default shard.

methods.name: _read_platform_sharding_config
methods.description: Reads the sharding configuration JSON file for a specific platform.

methods.name: _find_unmapped_test_chunks
methods.description: Identifies test chunks that have not been assigned in the current sharding configuration.

methods.name: _create_default_shard
methods.description: Creates the default shard containing all unmapped tests and chunks.

methods.name: get_test_run_config
methods.description: Returns the run configuration for a specific test target within a shard.
